justification: Both surfaces include schematic relief imagery with repeated sign-like motifs arranged in bands or panels, and both have some anthropomorphic/body-like content rather than purely abstract ornament. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by a frontal, centrally placed human/divine figure within a framed niche and surrounded by dense glyph-like panels, while A is mainly a looser field of profile animals, birds or animal-like forms and simple repeated motifs without the same central figure-and-frame scheme.
